FARM is a high-relevance but speculative micro-cap exception: direct restaurant/hospitality/foodservice coffee and tea exposure, DSD and equipment-service hooks, but needs balance-sheet, margin, customer-retention, and post-divestiture verification.

JVA is an obscure speculative-shadow candidate in wholesale green coffee and private-label coffee; include only if later filings confirm foodservice or restaurant-adjacent customer exposure and manageable customer concentration.
